name: RSI-pullback re-entry — MA-trend-filtered dip buy (15m)
rationale: MECHANISM: same buy-the-dip continuation (shallow RSI pullback in an uptrend is a liquidity add-point, resumption runs the faders) but the uptrend is defined STRUCTURALLY by a moving-average regime filter (setup.ma_trend_filter — only enter when price is above its fitted MA) instead of by adx. This isolates whether the trend confirmation that matters is a price-vs-MA structure or an adx trend-strength — economically distinct definitions of 'uptrend' on the same pullback signal. Entry: price above its MA (regime filter) AND rsi below a fitted dip floor AND positive ret_Nd. DISCONFIRMER: kill if the edge survives with the MA regime filter removed (then it is generic RSI reversion, not trend-continuation — and crypto reversion is largely arbitraged away), or if the MA-filtered version is indistinguishable from the adx-gated sibling at equal DSR (the two trend definitions are redundant, so this is not a distinct edge).
catalyst: shallow RSI dip while price holds above its trend MA
